name: Day trader (India)
description: A day-trading method for Indian stocks (NSE, rupees, IST): scan for setups, read the news and filings, time the entry, plan stop and target, size the position, check the limits, replay the odds, and follow insider and bulk-deal buying. Analysis only: it never places an order.

skills.name: day-trade-scan
skills.description: Find intraday setups on NSE stocks (opening-range breakout, oversold bounce) and check the index first

skills.name: day-trade-news
skills.description: Check the news and company filings on a stock before a day trade, and whether a result or event falls today

skills.name: day-trade-entry
skills.description: Say whether a setup has triggered on a stock yet, bar by bar, and when to skip it

skills.name: day-trade-exit
skills.description: Set the stop, the target and the square-off time before entering a day trade, and set reminders for the times

skills.name: day-trade-budget
skills.description: Size a day trade from the owner's max loss, money and leverage, with exact figures

skills.name: day-trade-risk
skills.description: Check a day-trade plan against the owner's own limits and say pass or block, with the reason

skills.name: day-trade-replay
skills.description: Before a trade, replay the rest of the session thousands of times from the stock's own candles and say how often the target or the stop comes first

skills.name: day-trade-analyst
skills.description: Read a company's latest results, filings and shareholding pattern and sum up what changed

skills.name: day-trade-smart-money
skills.description: Show what promoters, directors and big investors have been buying or selling: insider trades and bulk and block deals

tools.name: trade-plan
tools.description: Exact arithmetic for one long or short intraday trade: stop, target, quantity from the max loss, capital used, risk to reward, and which limits it breaks. Prices in rupees.

reward_multiple.description: Target as a multiple of the risk per share, for example 1.5

max_loss.description: The most the owner will lose on this trade, in rupees

capital.description: Money available for this trade, in rupees

leverage.description: Intraday leverage the owner has, 1 if none

min_reward_multiple.description: The owner's smallest acceptable reward to risk, 0 if none

tick.description: Price tick, 0.05 for most NSE stocks
